**Reviewed as of 2026-09-12 · 54 entries.**

Models with a documented spoken-response path. Some entries describe a research configuration or an API model; consult the notes before assuming the same capability in every checkpoint.

**Modalities:** T = text, I = image, V = video, A = general audio, S = speech, M = music, X = other structured modalities. A is a broad label, not a guarantee of every audio task. See the [methodology](../docs/methodology.md) for interaction labels, variant scope and inclusion rules.

Dates below refer to the linked paper or announcement, **not necessarily a weights/API release**. An em dash means no date was established from the reviewed source.

## Model notes

<a id="amazon-nova-2-sonic"></a>

### Amazon Nova 2 Sonic

Successor model with expanded spoken interaction and tool-use capabilities.

**Listed variants:** amazon.nova-2-sonic-v1:0.

<a id="amazon-nova-sonic"></a>

### Amazon Nova Sonic

Initial Nova Sonic conversational model served over a bidirectional streaming API.

**Listed variants:** amazon.nova-sonic-v1:0.

<a id="audio-flamingo-3"></a>

### Audio Flamingo 3

The paper includes voice-to-voice interaction; ordinary understanding checkpoints primarily emit text.

**Listed variants:** Understanding; voice-to-voice configuration.

<a id="baichuan-audio"></a>

### Baichuan-Audio

A separate audio model from the Baichuan-Omni family.

<a id="covo-audio"></a>

### Covo-Audio

Base and chat variants address speech understanding, generation and duplex interaction.

**Listed variants:** Base; Chat.

<a id="doubao-realtime-voice"></a>

### Doubao Realtime Voice

The initial end-to-end Doubao voice model; Seeduplex introduces the later full-duplex design.

<a id="duplexsla"></a>

### DuplexSLA

Produces spoken responses and structured tool/action outputs on a shared timeline.

<a id="f-actor"></a>

### F-Actor

Controls conversational behavior, speaker identity and interaction topic.

<a id="flow-omni"></a>

### Flow-Omni

Models continuous speech representations for spoken interaction.

<a id="freeze-omni"></a>

### Freeze-Omni

The text backbone remains frozen during speech alignment training.

<a id="fun-audio-chat"></a>

### Fun-Audio-Chat

Uses coarse speech groups in the shared LLM and a finer speech head.

<a id="glm-4-voice"></a>

### GLM-4-Voice

Chinese/English spoken chatbot with a low-rate speech tokenizer.

**Listed variants:** 9B.

<a id="gpt-4o-audio"></a>

### GPT-4o Audio

Chat Completions audio model; separate from the general GPT-4o endpoint.

**Listed variants:** gpt-4o-audio-preview.

<a id="gpt-4o-mini-audio"></a>

### GPT-4o Mini Audio

Preview API model accepting and generating audio.

**Listed variants:** gpt-4o-mini-audio-preview.

<a id="gpt-4o-mini-realtime"></a>

### GPT-4o Mini Realtime

Smaller realtime preview variant.

**Listed variants:** gpt-4o-mini-realtime-preview.

<a id="gpt-4o-realtime"></a>

### GPT-4o Realtime

Earlier realtime preview family with text/audio inputs and outputs.

**Listed variants:** gpt-4o-realtime-preview.

<a id="gpt-audio"></a>

### GPT-Audio

Generally available audio-input/output API model family.

**Listed variants:** gpt-audio.

<a id="gpt-audio-mini"></a>

### GPT-Audio Mini

Smaller audio-input/output API model; interaction limits follow its own documentation.

**Listed variants:** gpt-audio-mini.

<a id="gpt-audio-1-5"></a>

### GPT-Audio-1.5

Audio understanding and speech generation through Chat Completions.

**Listed variants:** gpt-audio-1.5.

<a id="gpt-live-1"></a>

### GPT-Live-1

Listens while speaking and can delegate reasoning or tool work to a backend model.

**Listed variants:** gpt-live-1.

<a id="grok-voice-think-fast"></a>

### Grok Voice Think Fast

Reasons while speaking; an API-level description does not establish simultaneous listening and speaking.

**Listed variants:** grok-voice-think-fast-1.0; grok-voice-think-fast-2.0; grok-voice-latest alias.

<a id="hume-evi-2"></a>

### Hume EVI 2

Native speech-language generation release of the Empathic Voice Interface.

**Listed variants:** EVI 2.

<a id="hume-evi-3"></a>

### Hume EVI 3

Unified conversational language and speech generation with controllable delivery.

**Listed variants:** hume-evi-3; hume-evi-3-websearch.

<a id="hume-octave-research-model"></a>

### Hume OCTAVE (research model)

The 2024 research demonstration includes language generation and multi-persona spoken interaction; commercial Octave TTS has a separate entry.

**Listed variants:** OCTAVE 3B demonstration.

<a id="intrinsicvoice"></a>

### IntrinsicVoice

Groups speech tokens to reduce the sequence-length gap with text.

<a id="kimi-audio"></a>

### Kimi-Audio

Audio understanding and speech generation with a streaming detokenizer.

**Listed variants:** 7B; 7B-Instruct.

<a id="lfm2-audio"></a>

### LFM2-Audio

Audio-specialized Liquid Foundation Model; see release-specific supported tasks.

**Listed variants:** LFM2-Audio-1.5B; LFM2.5-Audio-1.5B; LFM2.5-Audio-1.5B-JP.

<a id="llama-omni"></a>

### LLaMA-Omni

Speech-focused despite its name; no visual-input capability is asserted.

<a id="llama-omni-2"></a>

### LLaMA-Omni 2

Successor uses the Qwen2.5 family despite retaining the LLaMA-Omni name.

**Listed variants:** 0.5B–14B series.

<a id="lslm"></a>

### LSLM

Investigates listening while speaking and interruption handling.

<a id="lucy"></a>

### LUCY

Combines emotion-sensitive responses with external function calls.

<a id="lychee-fd"></a>

### Lychee-FD

Separates speech modeling responsibilities to reduce interference with language reasoning.

<a id="mimo-audio"></a>

### MiMo-Audio

Supports speech tasks, audio understanding and spoken dialogue.

**Listed variants:** 7B-Base; 7B-Instruct.

<a id="mini-omni"></a>

### Mini-Omni

Speech interaction model; visual input is introduced by Mini-Omni2.

<a id="minmo"></a>

### MinMo

Trains speech understanding, speech generation and interaction alignment in stages.

<a id="moshi"></a>

### Moshi

Models user and assistant audio streams with aligned text generation.

**Listed variants:** Moshiko; Moshika.

<a id="moss-speech"></a>

### MOSS-Speech

Its speech-response path does not require generated text guidance.

<a id="omniflatten"></a>

### OmniFlatten

Converts a text backbone into a duplex speech-text dialogue model.

<a id="opens2s"></a>

### OpenS2S

Builds empathetic spoken dialogue on BLSP-Emo.

<a id="personaplex"></a>

### PersonaPlex

Combines textual role prompts and voice conditioning.

**Listed variants:** 7B.

<a id="salmonn-omni"></a>

### SALMONN-omni

Uses a standalone speech model for context-dependent interruption and conversation.

<a id="seeduplex"></a>

### Seeduplex

Continuous listening, context-sensitive turn handling and interference suppression.

<a id="slam-omni"></a>

### SLAM-Omni

Separates timbre conditioning into the vocoder for controllable speech interaction.

<a id="slamming-slam"></a>

### Slamming / Slam

Research models trained with a compute-efficient recipe; unrelated to SLAM-Omni.

<a id="spectron"></a>

### Spectron

Direct spectrogram-based spoken QA and continuation; unrelated to the speaker-extraction model of the same name.

<a id="speechgpt"></a>

### SpeechGPT

Speech-text conversational model with staged cross-modal training.

<a id="speechgpt-2-0-preview"></a>

### SpeechGPT 2.0 Preview

Official preview release of the SpeechGPT successor.

**Listed variants:** 2.0-preview.

<a id="step-audio"></a>

### Step-Audio

The Chat model is distinct from the smaller Step-Audio-TTS generator.

**Listed variants:** Step-Audio-Chat.

<a id="step-audio-2"></a>

### Step-Audio 2

Combines audio reasoning, conversation and tool use.

**Listed variants:** Step-Audio-2-mini; Step-Audio-2-mini-Base.

<a id="step-audio-r1-1"></a>

### Step-Audio-R1.1

Separate reasoning and articulation paths allow thinking while speaking.

**Listed variants:** R1.1.

<a id="syncllm"></a>

### SyncLLM

Synchronizes speech-text prediction with elapsed time.

<a id="turnguide"></a>

### TurnGuide

Aligns text guidance with dual-channel speech timelines.

<a id="vita-audio"></a>

### VITA-Audio

Predicts multiple audio tokens per language-model pass.

<a id="voila"></a>

### Voila

Voice-language model for proactive, expressive interaction.
